steps: Focus canvas; D for one second moves right
Draw fixed obstacle; continue D and assert character right <=280
Undo/redo obstacle; capture spawn and undo/redo/reset it
Import decha.png, debg.png, audio/tone.m4a; save, cold open, conflict/copy/late read
topdown.criteria: Movement is positive; obstacle blocks the original 21px-wide foot hitbox; saved spawn, obstacle and selected versions survive cold open

steps: Focus canvas; W reaches original upper walk boundary; D moves right
Import decha.png, hou384.png, qian384.png and audio/tone.aac
Capture spawn, save, cold open and verify no new assets/tasks
arcade.criteria: Movement remains within the original walk band; foreground/background and character load; native music reaches playing; document versions stay identical

timingPolicy: Original movement is per animation callback, while animation timing uses dt. Preserve that behavior; do not require the same one-second displacement across different display refresh rates.
cancellation: Use only tests/support/gated_workbench.py delay-worker; assert visible canceled state, no late apply, then retry. This is startup-stage acceptance, not whole-decoder stop-time proof.
